## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit` and `npm test` pass (run from `electron/`)
- [ ] New logic in `electron/src/shared/` has a unit test
- [ ] Tried in the app (describe what you checked)
- [ ] The code matches the surrounding code and adds no dependency without discussion
- [ ] User-visible change: added a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] If an editor control changed: the agent op and the table in AGENTS.md changed too
- [ ] Screenshots for visible changes
